howto.name: Add the PDF
howto.text: Drop or select a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Reverse the order
howto.text: Run it. There are no options: the last page becomes the first and the first becomes the last.

howto.name: Download the result
howto.text: Save the reversed PDF. The pages themselves are copied unchanged.

faq.q: Why would I reverse a PDF?
faq.a: Most often because a scanner or printer produced the pages last-to-first. Reversing fixes the whole document in one step rather than dragging every page into place.

faq.q: Can I reverse only part of a document?
faq.a: No, the whole file is reversed. For a partial change, use Organize Pages, or split the section out, reverse it and merge it back.

faq.q: Does it change the pages themselves?
faq.a: No. Only the order changes; text, images and page sizes are copied as they are.

faq.q: I scanned odd and even pages separately. Will this help?
faq.a: Partly. Reverse the stack that came out backwards, then interleave the two files with Alternate Mix, which is built for exactly that single-sided-scanner workflow.

faq.q: Can I reverse several PDFs at once?
faq.a: One file at a time. Run it again for each document.

faq.q: What happens to my PDF after I upload it?
faq.a: It is uploaded over HTTPS and reordered on the PrivaTools server in isolated temporary per-request storage, using local libraries rather than a third-party service. Response cleanup removes the PDF and the result after your download is sent, and a background sweep clears anything an interrupted request leaves behind. Nothing is added to an account or file library.
